questions.question_norm: a network technician enters the following global command spanning tree portfast bpduguard enable what is accomplished with this command
answer_texts: It enables BPDU Guard on all Portfast enabled access ports.

questions.question: What occurs if a BPDU is received on a port enabled with BPDU Filter?
questions.question_norm: what occurs if a bpdu is received on a port enabled with bpdu filter
answer_texts: The BPDU is ignored and the port remains functional.
